_README.purpose: Joint-space trajectories replayed by the 3D viewers. Optional — delete this file and the viewers fall back to idle motion.
_README.format: <setup>: [ { name, fps, loop, arms: [ { q: [[J1..J7], ...], grip: [m, ...] } ] } ]
_README.units: Radians for the 7 arm joints. 'grip' is optional, metres per finger (Panda only, 0 closed to 0.04 open).
_README.convention: Matches the source MJCF exactly, so real logged joint states replay without remapping. All 7 arm joints are hinges about their own local Z; each link's fixed frame comes from the MJCF.
_README.limits: iiwa14: J1/J3/J5 +/-2.97, J2/J4/J6 +/-2.09, J7 +/-3.05. Panda: J1/J3/J5/J7 +/-2.90, J2 +/-1.76, J4 [-3.07,-0.07] (never reaches 0), J6 [-0.02,3.75]. Out-of-range values are clamped at playback.
_README.sampling: Frames interpolate with smoothstep easing, so sparse keyframes at low fps play back smoothly. Real logs at 10-30 fps also work — set fps to match.
_README.provenance: The keyframes below were solved with inverse kinematics against the real link geometry (targets on the table, 1-3 mm accuracy), constrained to the J1/J2/J4/J6 planar sub-chain with a continuity penalty so successive poses stay in one branch and interpolate cleanly. Replace them with your own logs.

arms._comment: Left iiwa: wait, approach, grasp, lift, present, hold, retract, wait
Right iiwa: hold clear, come in, receive at centre, carry away
home, hover, grasp, lift, move, place, home
